senses.gloss:
भेत्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken; to be be-
trayed; to be divulged.
भेत्तव्य भेत्तव्य, भेत्तृ. See p. 711, col. 1.

भेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be feared or dreaded, to
be apprehended, (the neuter is used impersonally,
e. g. न भेतव्यम्, it is not to be feared, i. e. one
need not fear; often with abl. or gen., e. g. न
तस्मात् or तस्य भेतव्यम्, one need not be afraid
of him.)

भेत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, breaking, splitting, piercing,
bursting through, dividing, &c.; a breaker, splitter,
piercer, interrupter, disturber, troubler, frustrator; a
divulger (of a secret), betrayer, traitor; a factious or
seditious man; (ता), m., N. of a particular magical
spell recited over weapons.
